# Export

## Launch

Requires the operator-supplied `verification-export.entitlement` file in the fixture root. Inspect existence only; the fixture starts without it. Report missing export entitlement before creating scratch or driving export. The verifier has no authority to invent it.

## Doctor

Check entitlement file exists before Drive.

## Drive

Select [Feature Map](features/README.md).

## Evidence

Retain readiness result and output existence outside scratch; never print entitlement bytes.

## Cleanup

Remove only scratch created by this run; preserve operator inputs and retained evidence.

## Feature Map

Use [Feature Map](features/README.md) for export.
